value.rationale: A natural scientific question is whether bounded oscillatory coexistence or more complex persistent recurrence can occur in a game whose local equilibria are studied. Risk-coordinate feedback forces an entire conditional mean calibration, allowing a strict impossibility threshold not implied by the two marginal means alone. An exact rational instance separates the two conclusions, demonstrating genuine mathematical leverage. The result explicitly avoids claiming extinction or sufficient conditions.
